summary.intro: After 10+ years in software engineering, progressing to senior and lead roles across frontend and full-stack development, consciously transitioning into embedded systems and open to starting at a junior level and salary to build hands-on commercial experience. Comfortable working with Arduino, STM32, and ESP32 boards, communication protocols (UART/SPI/I2C), and reading component datasheets to select and integrate hardware. Has built drone replacement/upgrade parts, an ESP32-based plotter/laser-cutter conversion, and automation devices, combining firmware work with the engineering discipline carried over from a decade of production software experience. Also has commercial experience building Python REST APIs (Flask, FastAPI, Django) with SQL databases. No commercial experience in embedded specifically yet, but a fast learning curve, a strong programming foundation, and a genuine, self-driven interest in hardware.

items.title: ESP32-Based Automation Devices
items.description: Designed and built automation devices on ESP32, covering firmware development, sensor integration over UART/SPI/I2C, and full hardware assembly.

items.title: 3D Printer Conversion into a Plotter & Laser Cutter
items.description: Converted a 3D printer into a plotter and a laser cutter on ESP32, implementing motor control and reworking the electronics and firmware for the new tool heads.

items.title: Drone Parts & Repairs
items.description: Designed and 3D-printed replacement and upgrade parts for drones, and performed hands-on assembly and repair work.

achievements.title: Hackathon Contributor
achievements.description: Completed courses on drone management and assembly. Participated in a hackathon focused on developing software for drones.

hobbies.title: Electronics & DIY Automation
hobbies.description: Tinkers with Arduino/ESP32-based projects at home: sensors, automation devices, and hardware repairs and mods for drones and 3D printers.
